SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, MIN(calendar_date) d0, MAX(calendar_date) d1, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) closed
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl, MIN(etl_loaded_at) e0, MAX(etl_loaded_at) e1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) rpt_all, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN r.net_sales END) rpt_stores, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) rpt_web, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN r.net_sales END) rpt_999
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) tot, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN n.net_sales END) stores, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales END) web
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.fiscal_week, m.tot, m.stores, m.web, c.rpt_all, c.rpt_stores, c.rpt_web, c.rpt_999
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, r.business_date, d.holiday_name, COUNT(*) stores_rows, SUM(r.net_sales) net, SUM(r.receipts) receipts
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<>999
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) s999,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) zz,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 OR f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) odd_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(f.net_amount) net, MIN(f.sale_date) d0, MAX(f.sale_date) d1, SUM(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-01' AND DATE '2026-07-15' GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS this_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS last_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
